open_items: 128x128 FF 1.1 V -40 C seq fails: far-end cells of the read row (columns 0-11, 64-73) flip during the read. Each half-array joins its bitcell VSS M3 row rails to one M4 trunk at one end; the far columns' ground rises at least 0.35 V (0.19 V at SF -40 C, where their sense margin is 0.323 V against 0.252 V). Read-row transfer resistance far - near doubles per size (7.6/15.6/31.7/63.8 ohm at 32/64/128/256), so 256x256 and 512x512 reads are not expected to pass. Planned fix (next round, decision of 2026-10-31): vertical M4 VSS straps tying the array rails into a mesh; then rebuild, Calibre and the 32/64/128 matrix again
